title: Grateful Dead Live at Roosevelt Stadium on 1973-08-01
taper: Uher mic > Uher 4000 Report L 5" reels > MacIntosh pre-amp > TEAC 1230 7" reel.

ai_review.summary: A raw soundboard capture delivers a spirited show highlighted by a grooving Dark Star, soaring Eyes of the World and an emotional first‑time Sugar Magnolia.
ai_review.review: The recording preserves the uncompressed, ‘teeth‑y’ sound of a classic Dead night, with only occasional vocal clipping and a brief mic‑cable glitch that many fans find authentic. Musically the band is energized – Stella Blue, Eyes of the World, Dark Star (even venturing into El Paso), Morning Dew and a tear‑inducing Sugar Magnolia are repeatedly praised as standouts.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave 4–5 stars and highlighted strong performances plus a generally enjoyable raw soundboard, outweighing minor technical quirks.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Raw, uncompressed sound with plenty of ‘teeth’; occasional vocal clipping on Eyes of the World, a mic‑cable jiggle and a brief pause‑like glitch on Casey Jones, but overall clear and lively.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic first set leading into an unusual second‑set opener (Around and Around) that still maintains high momentum; the night builds to powerful peaks with Dark Star and a heartfelt Sugar Magnolia.
